title: [yang] sample-chassis-packet-lc-graph is using invalid switch_type
author: ganglyu
body:

#### Description

<!--
     Briefly describe the problem you are having in a few paragraphs.
-->
https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/blob/master/src/sonic-config-engine/tests/sample-chassis-packet-lc-graph.xml#L397
https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/blob/master/src/sonic-config-engine/tests/sample-chassis-packet-lc-graph.xml#L462
Switch_type is 'chassis_packet', and it does not match pattern in:
https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/blob/master/src/sonic-yang-models/yang-models/sonic-device_metadata.yang#L174-L176

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
Check sample-chassis-packet-lc-graph.xml and run unit test.

#### Describe the results you received:
chassis_packet is not in pattern.

#### Describe the results you expected:
switch_type should match pattern.
